mapper.select: select coalesce(max(id), 0) + 1 as newid from tb_videos
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_videos ( id, title, video_type, youtube_video_id, file_url, description, duration, views, thumbnail, created_by, created_at )VALUES ( #{id}, #{title}, #{videoType}, #{youtubeVideoId}, #{fileUrl}, #{description}, #{duration}, #{views}, #{thumbnail}, #{createdBy}, now() )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, title, video_type as videoType, youtube_video_id as youtubeVideoId, file_url as fileUrl, description, duration as duration, views as views, thumbnail, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt FROM tb_videos WHERE 1=1
AND id = CAST(#{id} AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
